Your 30-Day Journey

From Zero To Your First Sale

A complete, day-by-day 30-day action plan we walk through with you — from setup to your first real orders.

📅 30 Days · 4 Weeks 🎯 Goal: First Sale Within 30 Days 🤝 1-on-1 Support Included
Week 1 · Foundation

Setup & Research

Day 1 – Day 7
  • Free 1-on-1 consultation call to understand your goals & budget
  • Niche selection & winning product research
  • Supplier sourcing & pricing finalization
  • Business profile setup (WhatsApp / Instagram / Marketplace)
  • Store / page branding — logo, bio, theme
  • Domain & basic store structure ready
Week 2 · Build

Store & Listings Go Live

Day 8 – Day 14
  • Full store / catalog setup with product listings
  • Product titles, descriptions & images optimized for SEO
  • Payment gateway & order process connected
  • WhatsApp auto-reply & broadcast lists configured
  • Social media content calendar created
  • Store goes LIVE and is ready to take orders
Week 3 · Launch

Traffic & First Orders

Day 15 – Day 21
  • Ad campaigns launched (Meta / Google Ads)
  • Organic content & reels posted with viral hooks
  • Hashtag & outreach strategy executed
  • Daily order & inquiry monitoring with you
  • First customer messages & orders start coming in
  • Quick fixes & A/B testing on ads and listings
Week 4 · Scale

Optimize & Grow Income

Day 22 – Day 30
  • Performance review — what's working, what to scale
  • Budget reallocation to best-performing products/ads
  • Customer feedback & review collection system
  • Repeat customer & retention strategy set up
  • Growth roadmap for Month 2 handed to you
  • Final mentorship call — you're ready to scale on your own
🚀 By Day 30, your business is fully live, generating real orders, and you have a clear growth plan to keep scaling — with full support from our team every step of the way.
